topic: Git e GitHub CLI no Termux
rules: Configurar branch padrão main ao iniciar repositórios.
Commits limpos com mensagens sem aspas quebradas.

recipes.trigger: iniciar e subir repositorio no github
recipes.command: git init && git add . && git commit -m 'Release VERY SYSTEMS' && git branch -M main && gh repo create --public --source=. --push

recipes.trigger: ver status e historico compacto do git
recipes.command: git status -s && echo '--- Últimos commits ---' && git log --oneline -n 5
